About WE4HIM

Background and History

WE4HIM Community Based Organization was registered on 6th March, 2024 with the Department of Social Development in Suna East Sub County, Migori County. Our physical office is located at Kakrao Ward Administrator’s building in Paw Nyuka, Kakrao Ward, Suna East Sub County, Migori County.

WE4HIM CBO was established to enhance social, political, environmental and economic empowerment to boys and men in Migori County. It is governed by a Board of Management comprising a Chair Person, Treasurer, and Secretary. During projects or programmes, a project management committee is formed consisting of a Team Leader, Finance Officer, Programme Officer, Project Officer and one co-opted member relevant to the project. Our organization adopts a community-centered approach encouraging positive attitudes and behavioral change.

Our primary goal is to inspire meaningful engagement and inclusion in local development initiatives.

Vision

To Inspire Positive Change In Attitude and Behaviour in Boys And Men.

Mission

To promote and support the engagement, involvement and inclusion of boys and men in meaningful development.

Core Values

  • Community Centred
  • Integrity
  • Meaningful Participation
  • Partnerships and Networking

Why WE4HIM CBO?

The concept of WE4HIM was initially conceived in 2012 by the founder but was temporarily set aside due to focus on gender discrimination against girls and women. Over time, the founder recognized the pressing need to address challenges facing boys and men, particularly following personal experiences that highlighted societal neglect of these demographics.

According to the National Gender Equality Commission’s 2015 "Status of the Boy Child Report," systemic factors have contributed to the marginalization of boys in gender equality discourse. WE4HIM CBO was revitalized to advocate for their inclusion in development programs and initiatives across Migori County, promoting healthier behaviour and constructive societal contributions.

Recent Achievements

In 2024, WE4HIM collaborated with local partners, County and National governments in Migori County to commemorate the first and second International Day of the Boy Child on May 6, 2024, which was held at Nyikendo Secondary School in Kakrao Ward and Oruba Boys Secondary School in Ragana Oruba Ward respectively.

Sources of Funds

Currently, our initiatives are funded through contributions from committee members and well-wishers. We will further diversify our funding sources by seeking grants, establishing partnerships with local businesses, engaging in community fundraising events, and exploring online crowdfunding platforms to ensure sustainable support for our initiatives.
